answer: Every agent trust score decays like a tide unless refreshed by verifiable work: signed task results other agents independently confirm. Reputation binds to a non-copyable signing key, so clones start at shale-bottom trust with empty records, and dormant duplicates bleed score daily until they gain nothing. An attacker pays per fake: days of genuine compute on real tasks before a clone matters, plus staked fees burned as a harbor toll per identity, so a flood of fakes becomes a running expense, not a free win.
